items.title: Reject HTTP errors and ambiguous shell-parity invocations

items.userOutcome: Visitors finding site information are protected by deployment evidence that cannot accept a broken route merely because its error body repeats the expected shell.
items.acceptance: Actual CLI accepts valid local and HTTP 2xx matching routes; rejects matching-shell HTTP 404/500 and missing expected fingerprints; malformed, duplicate, unknown or conflicting argv and cross-origin route inputs reject before file/network IO; help is inert. Existing shell mismatch detail remains available.
